answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The zephyr is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the horizon. What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
